name: Liquid I.V. Hydration Multiplier (Lemon Lime)
whyItWorks: Engineered on the World Health Organization (WHO) Oral Rehydration Solution guidelines, using Cellular Transport Technology (CTT). The precise 2:1 ratio of glucose to sodium activates the SGLT1 transporter in the small bowel, pulling water into the bloodstream without demanding digestive exertion.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Mix 1 packet into exactly 16 oz of cool water. Do not over-dilute or concentrate, as precise osmolarity maximizes rapid intestinal absorption.
